ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) base with approximately 15-20% coverage of high-intensity (white) linear and focal features.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid black ground across both lobes; dense lattice of high-contrast white linear streaks; small irregular high-intensity patches at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression; approximate interior angle of 135 degrees; depth at center partially occluded by water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks/valleys) along the entire trailing boundary; notable irregular 'jagged' profile on the medial trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetric convex curvature sweeping from the central notch to the distal tips; curvature radius tightens significantly at the outer lobe edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small high-contrast circular clusters detected at the extreme distal tips, particularly a prominent yellowish-white cluster on the right tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense, overlapping network of high-contrast white linear scratches (rake marks) across the entire visible surface; varies from short 10px strokes to long 150px diagonal marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks across both lobes; irregular growth or accumulation on the right distal tip; jagged indentation on the left medial trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: The density and non-linear intersection of rake marks creates a unique 'etched' visual texture across the ventral surface.
